description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt project to manage system diagnostics LEDs. It defines functions to identify the status LED and set different LED states based on system status such as preinitialization, failsafe, and completion.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Identifies the status LED device by searching for specific LED names in the system LED directory.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED indicator state based on the provided argument such as 'preinit', 'failsafe', or 'done'.
